notes.title: Huge Update - Version 2.0 - New Languages, improved gameplay +more
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36142644/b30bfedd3982f40f6be2a6046c512e8fe35783e4.gif[/img]
Hello folks, I'm here with my newest update, time for SHAPESHOOTER! For this game I added new languages and improved gameplay aspects aswell!
[h3]New Languages[/h3]
Following my effort to make my games more accessible I've added 8 new languages:
[list][*] Portuguese - BR
[*] Spanish
[*] Japanese
[*] Russian
[*] Simplified Chinese
[*] Traditional Chinese
[*] Korean
[*] German[/list]
[h3]Gameplay Improvements[/h3]
[list][*] Receiving damage now gives the player 2 seconds of invulnerability, and everything does the same amount damage to the player. (So now, if the player get stuck in a laser, it will not die instantaneously)
[*] Checkpoints now store the ammo of the player
[*] Ammo pickup now scrolls betwen weapons the player own [/list]
[h3]Quality of Life improvements[/h3]
[list][*] Rumble funcion for the controller
[*] Aim assist (that can be disabled)
[*] Toggle between fullscreen and borderles windowed
[*] Possibility to reset progress and achievements[/list]
[h3]Balancing [/h3]
[list][*] Increased the time to complete all stages by about 30%[/list]
[h3]Graphics[/h3]
[list][*] New background for the main menu[/list]

I would like to ask you guys to check on the game I'm working, Burning Skies wich will be released this year, and if you like it, please wishlist it.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1915690/Burning_Skies/

And join my discord Server for news and updates before everyone else:

[url=https://discord.nukgames.com/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36142644/b77b2f0b3688bfda9a9af8483e459cf3a1dfd1f7.gif[/img][/url]

Thank you!
Paulo

notes.title: Shapeshooter Ver 1.03
notes.notes:
Hello friends, small update available now:

[list][*] Fixed a bug where sometimes shooting with the buckshot it could crash the game;

[*] Fixed a bug where if the player dies behind the checkpoint, the tank would not move to the checkpoint position

[*] Fixed a bug where sometimes destroying the SQUARE enemy cound crash the game.

[*] Fixed a bug where if the player shot an enemy very close to it, the shot color would not matter. 

[*] Fixed a bug where if the player connect the controller after the game had started, it would cause the turret to aim on a fixed direction

[*] Now if the controller is disconnected when playing the game would pause. 

[*] Fixed a bug where the screen would shake indefinitely on the stage 2-2 if the player stops the tank. [/list]

If you have any feedback, please join our discord server for better comunication. 

discord.nukgames.com

Thanks for the support. 
Paulo

notes.title: Shapeshooter!
notes.notes:
Hello folks, it's been a while since the last update and I have BIG NEWS!

I decided to change the name of our next game to Shapeshooter, visuals and mechanics also had a big change in direction! 

The reason to change are to make it possible to have a more diverse gameplay experience, and the name changed to be simpler and because of the changes, the game was too distant to Polygoneer to be considered a sequel.

[b]The game will come out in Q3 2020 and I'll share a precise date in a near futurem please follow and add to your wishlist to receive updates.[/b]


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1143900/Shapeshooter/

Thank you guys for all the support trough this years, it's not been easy lately but I'm back on track doing my best to deliver a cool game for your enjoyment.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_yKtPGoOjr0
